hardware: two NVIDIA RTX A4000 GPUs without NVLink

implementation.decomposition: Pad three momentum-force components to four and shard two components per GPU.
implementation.local_execution: Each GPU solves its two PCGs sequentially, preserving independent convergence.
implementation.communication: Inputs are explicitly replicated once; responses are collectively replicated inside the compiled Schur action.
implementation.portable_coverage: The generic component callback is exercised by an existing projection test; the shard_map kernel is a two-GPU hardware lane.

rejected_full_gmres_wiring.reason: Cold compilation exceeded 180 seconds with both GPUs idle both before and after Schur/preconditioner JIT separation; nesting shard_map under the monolithic full-GMRES transform remains inadmissible.
rejected_full_gmres_wiring.retained_code: Only the exact local-pair kernel and generic component-inverse hook.

separated_one_gpu_pressure_kernels.change: Materialize modal factors, then cache non-inline Schur and preconditioner JIT boundaries before tracing GMRES.

next_gate: Keep GMRES outside a monolithic multi-device XLA transform and invoke the already-compiled exact Schur and preconditioner kernels through bounded differentiable call boundaries.
